drafts.subject: Re: jac-cloud on Kubernetes?
drafts.message:
Hi Amara,

Thanks for reaching out. Great questions — here are the answers:

1. Yes, jac-cloud supports deployment on self-managed Kubernetes clusters, including EKS. It follows standard Kubernetes deployment practices, so you can deploy it into your existing cluster without requiring a managed jac-cloud offering.

2. Walker horizontal scaling follows standard Kubernetes conventions. You configure a HorizontalPodAutoscaler (HPA) on the walker-serving deployment, and scaling is then handled automatically based on the metrics you define. Graph state is externalized, so pods scale independently — no need to manually manage replicas once HPA is set up.

Happy to go deeper on either point if you'd like to discuss your Q4 timeline and configuration specifics.

Best,
impact@jaseci.org
